start_rule.reason: deterministic beginning/middle/trailing-10-action coverage; no selection by performance

randomization: Each block/seed uses fixed SHA256-derived sampling and FM RNG keys; same keys and explicit initial noise for E0/E1; average all seeds, never pick best noise.

selection.E0_role: comparison only; never an E1 checkpoint candidate

physical_reporting.xyz: per-component RMSE/MAE in meters plus Euclidean RMSE
physical_reporting.euler: per-component increment RMSE/MAE in radians; no cumulative orientation or geodesic claim
physical_reporting.gripper: feedback-position RMSE/MAE in candidate units; not a controller command
physical_reporting.aggregation: MSE/MAE averaged within block then block/seed then episode then dataset; RMSE=sqrt(dataset MSE)

task_phase_status: UNKNOWN; temporal block labels are not identified grasp/place stages
ground_truth: offline feedback-derived adjacent action increments; not robot success
